drafts.title: Getting Your Revenue Team AI-Ready (without betting the brand on it)
drafts.content:
**You can't automate a mess — and you can't let an AI write your way out of one either.**

Getting a revenue team AI-ready isn't about buying the loudest platform. It's the map you build before the climb: clean the pipeline, agree on definitions, and decide what an AI is allowed to do before it does anything.

Start with three concrete deliverables. A governed glossary so 'MQL' and 'Qualified' mean the same thing to marketing and sales. A claims standard so nothing reaches the market that you can't substantiate. And an approval gate so an AI assists your team long before it ever acts on its own.

Do that, and AI stops being a risk you're bracing for and becomes the next stretch of the climb — taken with intention.
